newsitem.title: CHINA: GUJING DISTILLERY H1 NET UP 4.86 PCT.
newsitem.headline: GUJING DISTILLERY H1 NET UP 4.86 PCT.

text.p: Results for the half-year ended June 30, 1997 (year-on-year in millions of yuan unless stated):
Earnings per share 0.60 yuan vs 0.62 yuan
Net assets per share 3.83 yuan vs 2.81 yuan
Company name: Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd.
NOTE: The unaudited results, calculated under Chinese accounting standards, were published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Tuesday.
Based on international standards, the distillery reaped 139.0 million yuan in the first six months of 1997. It gave no comparative figure.
Trading in Gujing A and B shares was suspended on Tuesday morning pending the announcement, but would resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
